For the last part of this assignment, you will apply the quartet-summary method
`ASTRAL` to a larger gene tree dataset. `ASTRAL` is a method for phylogenetic
reconstruction that tallies quartet gene tree topologies and reconciles them
to infer a larger, single species-level phylogeny. The documentation for 
`ASTRAL` is available at https://github.com/smirarab/ASTRAL. 

For the data, you will be applying `ASTRAL` to a set of gene trees inferred
from transcriptome data collected from wild relatives of the tomato, in the 
clade *Solanum*. The data source is this paper: 

https://journals.plos.org/plosbiology/article?id=10.1371/journal.pbio.1002379

The relevant data file is included in your folder for this lab assignment
and is named `Pease_etal_TomatoPhylo_100kbTrees_ASTRAL.tre`. Follow the 
directions in the documentation for `ASTRAL` to run it on this dataset at the
command line. Load the reconstructed tree into this assignment worksheet
and plot it: 

```{r}

```
